summary: Reconstructed quadrilateral ABCD as standalone TikZ (version 1, compiled and validated). Vertices come from bind_point_labels (A, B, C, D), with solid edges AB, BC, CD, DA and no dashed segments. Right-angle marks at C and A were verified by detect_right_angle_marker and are drawn in the TikZ. The critic scored it 0.93 with checklist 1.0, must_repair false, and all four labels present.
